verdict.rationale: Trello's marketing claims you can "Automate tasks and workflows with Trello" [trello-docs-3], which shows automation exists. Nothing in the pack shows it is no-code or supports multi-step rules, and the board-button and Power-Up material is developer-oriented and requires code. missing for 10: evidence of a no-code rule/automation builder, multi-step trigger-action chaining, documentation depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
